say:0:1810762101:0.text: Estrilda places the cure into Rain's hands, but he hesitates.
say:0:1810762101:0.source_cn: 爱丝将解药交到了里纳手中。然而，里纳却似乎有些犹豫。

say:4:1810762102:1.text: What is it? Is there something wrong with the medicine?
say:4:1810762102:1.source_cn: 怎么了？这瓶药有什么不对吗？

say:5:1810762103:0.source_cn: 不……不是。我只是有点……犹豫。

choice_prompt:6:1810762103.source_cn: 不……不是。我只是有点……犹豫。

say:7:1810762104:0.text: I'm afraid that once I remember, I'll understand why Thane stopped me.
say:7:1810762104:0.source_cn: ……我害怕恢复记忆以后，就会理解你和瑟恩所做的一切。

say:8:1810762105:0.text: And if that happens... it feels like I'm betraying Baba Muriel.
say:8:1810762105:0.source_cn: 可是这样……或许对穆婆婆不公平。

say:9:1810762106:0.text: I don't ask for your forgiveness, Baden. The moment I decided to stop you, I accepted the consequences.
say:9:1810762106:0.source_cn: 我不奢求你的理解和原谅。下定决心阻拦你的那一刻，我就已...

say:10:1810762107:0.text: You could refuse the cure. You could continue living as "Rain".
say:10:1810762107:0.source_cn: 你也可以拒绝恢复记忆，以“里纳”的身份继续活下去。

say:11:1810762108:1.text:
...
You know perfectly well that "Baden" wouldn't make that choice.

say:12:1810762109:0.text: Whatever you choose, I stand by it. I swore an oath to protect Estrilda and House Rayne until my heart stops beating.
say:12:1810762109:0.source_cn: 无论你作何选择，我都不会有怨言。我已发誓守护爱丝和瑞恩...

say:16:1810762111:0.text: Mr. Baden... No, Mr. Rain. If you don't mind, please hear the perspective of a Graveborn.
say:16:1810762111:0.source_cn: 巴登先生……不，里纳先生。若你不介意，请听听我作为亡灵...

say:17:1810762112:0.text: I don't know the full story, but I know this. Baba Muriel's sacrifice was her own choice, born entirely from her heart. She wanted to save you.
say:17:1810762112:0.source_cn: 虽然不清楚事情的具体经过，但我想，穆婆婆所做的一切必定...

say:18:1810762113:0.text: Her devotion to you was a truth written plain as day for everyone at the Repair House to see.
say:18:1810762113:0.source_cn: 毕竟她对你的爱护，每一位修缮屋的客人都有目共睹。

say:19:1810762114:1.text: That's exactly why I can't forgive myself!
say:19:1810762114:1.source_cn: 就是因为这样，我才无法原谅自己……！

say:20:1810762115:1.text: I understand your pain. But death is not the final curtain.
say:20:1810762115:1.source_cn: 我明白你的痛苦。但这不是生命的终点。

say:21:1810762116:1.text: Just as death is not the end for the living... fading away isn't the end for the Graveborn. <style="highlight">To be forgotten is the only true end.</style>
say:21:1810762116:1.source_cn: 就像死亡不是生者的终点，消散也不是亡灵的终点。<sty...

say:23:1810762118:1.text: Yes. Just like in my play, Lost Voice. As long as you remember her, her soul and her will live on through you.
say:23:1810762118:1.source_cn: 是的。如同我所演出的《消逝之声》那样，只要你记得穆婆婆...

say:24:1810762119:1.text: Your life is the treasure she gave everything to protect. If you waste it away in despair, her spirit will truly weep.
say:24:1810762119:1.source_cn: 你的生命，你的人生，是她拼尽全力也要保护的最宝贵之物。...

say:25:1810762120:1.text: Honor her sacrifice. Reclaim your past, carry her memory forward, and let the warmth she gave you bridge the gap between life and death for others.
say:25:1810762120:1.source_cn: 请不要辜负她的牺牲。找回属于你的过去，带着对她的思念活...

say:26:1810762121:1.text: Bridge the gap between life and death...

say:35:1810764101:1.source_cn: 我……我的记忆……我想起来了……<key:dialog1>

say:38:1810764104:0.text: Easy there, Estrilda. You're the head of the house now, no more crying like a kid.
say:38:1810764104:0.source_cn: 好啦，爱丝……你现在可是家主，不能再哭鼻子了。

say:41:1810764105:0.text: And you, Thane. Look a little happier, would you? Let's see a smile.
say:41:1810764105:0.source_cn: 还有瑟恩，你不应该更高兴吗？笑一笑吧。

say:42:1810764106:0.text: ... You don't have to put on a brave face for us, Baden.

say:44:1810764108:0.text: About Baba Muriel... I am truly sorry. But I had to make that choice.
say:44:1810764108:0.source_cn: 穆婆婆的事……对不起。那是我必须做的选择。

say:46:1810764110:0.text: Thank you, Thane. For raising Estrilda, for searching for me, for risking your life for me over and over again. You've already done more than enough. Stop blaming yourself.
say:46:1810764110:0.source_cn: 谢谢你，瑟恩。培养爱丝、寻找我、一次次舍身救我……你已...

say:47:1810764111:0.text:
I could never hate you.
I just... need a moment to grieve.
say:47:1810764111:0.source_cn: 我不会责怪你，更不会恨你。\n只是我现在……有点悲伤。

say:49:1810764113:0.text: We've fought Bantus for so long, we always thought the Graveborn were just soulless, unfeeling monsters. But... Baba Muriel gave up her existence just to save me.
say:49:1810764113:0.source_cn: 我们一直与班题斯为敌，总觉得亡灵全是毫无人性的怪物。可...

say:50:1810764114:1.text: Maybe she got some of Bayanu's memories... but the warmth and care she gave me while I was "Rain" were entirely real.
say:50:1810764114:1.source_cn: 虽然她的确受到了巴亚茄老师记忆的影响……但在我以“里纳...

say:51:1810764115:1.text: She was a Graveborn, she knew I was a human... and right now, I'm grieving her loss.
say:51:1810764115:1.source_cn: 她是亡灵，也知道我是生者……而我现在，正在为她的离开而痛苦。

say:54:1810764118:1.text: Do you remember what our commander used to drill into us? "When someone falls—"
say:54:1810764118:1.source_cn: 你还记得我们教官常说的话吧？“有人倒下后——”

say:55:1810764119:1.text: "We become the path they left unfinished."

say:56:1810764120:1.text: So live well. That's how you honor her sacrifice.
say:56:1810764120:1.source_cn: 所以，你好好活着，就不负她的牺牲。

say:58:1810764122:0.text: By the way, how did you two even end up in Novaris? How are things in Ashvale County? Who's holding the line?
say:58:1810764122:0.source_cn: 对了，为什么你和爱丝都跑到诺珐斯来了？灰影郡战况如何？...

say:61:1810764123:0.text: Sorry. After Thane left, I couldn't just sit at home and wait.
say:61:1810764123:0.source_cn: 对不起。瑟恩离开后，我实在没法安心待在灰影郡干等着。<...

say:62:1810764124:0.text: So... I abandoned my post and came after him. But don't worry! I handled everything I could think of before leaving!
say:62:1810764124:0.source_cn: 所以……我就擅自离岗了。但你不用担心，我把能想到的事情...

say:63:1810764125:0.text: Estrilda gives Baden a quick summary of the defensive arrangements she made before departing.
say:63:1810764125:0.source_cn: 爱丝特瑞达向巴登简单叙述了一遍她的安排。<key:di...

say:64:1810764126:1.text: Well done, Estrilda. You've grown into a real leader. House Rayne is in good hands.
say:64:1810764126:1.source_cn: 干得好，爱丝……你比以前稳重了很多。不愧是我们瑞恩家族...

say:65:1810764127:1.text: Baden... I abandoned my post. I don't deserve to remain head of the family.
say:65:1810764127:1.source_cn: 巴登，我擅离职守，不配再为家主，理应受罚。

say:66:1810764128:1.text: When you return to Ashvale County, I'll accept my punishment.
say:66:1810764128:1.source_cn: 等你回到灰影郡后，以家主的身份处置我吧。

say:67:1810764129:1.text: No. <style="highlight">I won't be returning to Ashvale County just yet.</style>

say:69:1810764131:1.text: To the Whispering Isles. I need to see what happened there myself.
say:69:1810764131:1.source_cn: 去幽声群岛，看看那里的情况。

say:70:1810764132:1.text: The fact that Baba Muriel inherited Bayanu's limbs means the conflict there is much worse than we thought.
say:70:1810764132:1.source_cn: 巴亚茄老师的肢体被穆婆婆所继承，说明幽声群岛的战况不容...

say:71:1810764133:0.text: But you just got your memories back! At least come home first...
say:71:1810764133:0.source_cn: 可是你才刚找回记忆！至少……至少也该回灰影郡看看……

say:75:1810764135:0.text: A soft, melodic laugh echoes through the room as Tephesia suddenly appears beside you.
say:75:1810764135:0.source_cn: 伴随着轻快的笑声，苔佩希的身影忽然出现在了你身边。<k...
say:75:1810764135:0.male: A soft, melodic laugh echoes through the room as Tephesia suddenly appears beside you.
say:75:1810764135:0.female: A soft, melodic laugh echoes through the room as Tephesia suddenly appears beside you.

say:76:1810764136:0.text: Miss Rayne, you really are delightfully naive. The nightmare unfolding in the Whispering Isles is far more wretched than you realize.
say:76:1810764136:0.source_cn: 瑞恩小姐，你太天真了。幽声群岛的现状比你们的预估更为可怕。

say:77:1810764137:0.text: Come now, let my messenger show you the intelligence we've gathered on Bantus.
say:77:1810764137:0.source_cn: 来吧，让余的信使给你们看看班题斯的情报。

document:81:614:0.text:
...
Hodgkin's Dead Tide Fleet was reportedly wiped out at Rustport in the Lightbearer Empire, and the Void Relic lost by Bantus is said to have fallen into the hands of an unidentified mage.

The military fleet pursuing the Dead Tide Fleet has changed course, suggesting Bantus does not intend to attack Rustport.
...
Bantus' military fleet has reached the Whispering Isles to reinforce the troops stationed there. The native islanders are losing ground.
...
Two-thirds of the islands in the Whispering Isles have been occupied by Bantus forces.

Thoran's latest order: Recall half of the Whispering Isles garrison to Bantus territory for regrouping and redeployment to the northern front.
...
Three Bantus military encampments near Ashvale County have been destroyed.

Thoran has ordered a headcount of all troops and the preparation of supplies for reinforcements bound for Ashvale County.

With more than ten battles taking place simultaneously along the borders and forces stretched thin, the preparation will take at least three months.
...
Grezhul's troops have sent a messenger back to Bantus capital to report the latest updates in Novaris. Interception units have already been deployed.

Grezhul's survival status is unconfirmed.
document:81:614:0.source_cn:
………………
传闻霍德希金所率领的死潮舰队已于耀光帝国锈锚港覆灭，班题斯遗失之圣器落入一魔法师手中，其身份尚不明确。
追踪死潮舰队的军方船队已转向。班题斯并没有将锈锚港列为应征服地区。
………………
班题斯军方船队已抵达耀光帝国边陲的幽声群岛，支援此地军队。群岛土著居民落入下风。
………………
耀光帝国幽声群岛三分之二岛屿已被班题斯军队占领。
托安最新命令：调遣幽声群岛一半军力返回班题斯境内，待修整后投入北面战场。
………………
三个位于耀光帝国灰影郡周边的班题斯军营已被捣毁。
托安已下令清点士兵、筹备物资，整军派往灰影郡增援。
考虑到班题斯边境存在十余处战场，战力吃紧，预估此次增援行动至少需要三月时间。
………………
格瑞泽尔勒所率领军队已命信使快马返回班题斯国都，呈报诺珐斯近况。已派人前往阻截。
另，格瑞泽尔勒生死暂不明确。

say:86:1810766103:0.source_cn: 余自然有自己的情报渠道。咳……不然真以为莫蒂默家族只是...

say:88:1810766104:0.text: The Whispering Isles are nearly lost... And Bantus is already preparing an offensive on Ashvale County...
say:88:1810766104:0.source_cn: 幽声群岛几乎完全沦陷，班题斯还在筹备攻打灰影郡的行动…...

say:89:1810766105:0.text: Estrilda, Thane. Return home immediately. I need to go to the Whispering Isles!
say:89:1810766105:0.source_cn: 爱丝，瑟恩，你们尽快返回灰影郡。我得去幽声群岛！<ke...

say:90:1810766106:0.text: Why the rush? Ashvale County may have belonged to Bantus once, but now it's under the Lightbearer Empire's protection. Taking it will be no easy feat.
say:90:1810766106:0.source_cn: 前家主先生，何必如此心急？虽说灰影郡曾是班题斯旧土，但...

say:91:1810766107:0.source_cn: 眼下，托安的目标恐怕会转向另一座孤立无援的城池……<k...

say:94:1810766111:0.source_cn: 转化器被毁，黑金商会在诺珐斯的部署化为乌有，格瑞泽尔勒...

say:95:1810766112:0.text: Bantus is short on military might, so he'll redirect the forces originally meant for Ashvale County.
say:95:1810766112:0.source_cn: 班题斯战力不足，必定会调用原定要增援灰影郡的军队。除此...

say:96:1810766113:0.source_cn: 所以，比起灰影郡，诺珐斯更为危急，但只要余能在大军抵达...

say:99:1810766115:0.text: Heh... It seems your knowledge of vampires is rather limited.
say:99:1810766115:0.source_cn: 呵呵……瑞恩小姐，看来你对吸血鬼的事情知之甚少呀。<k...

say:100:1810766116:0.text: ... I'll make sure to study the subject when I have time.

say:101:1810766117:0.text: Baden... Do you really have to go? I don't want anything else to happen to you.
say:101:1810766117:0.source_cn: 巴登，你一定要去幽声群岛吗？我不希望你再出任何意外了。

say:102:1810766118:0.text: The islands occupy a critical position. From there, Bantus can reach Ashvale County and Novaris with ease. They'll never abandon such a vital foothold.
say:102:1810766118:0.source_cn: 那里位置特殊，增援灰影郡或是诺珐斯都极为便利，班题斯绝...

say:103:1810766119:0.text: Whether they take Novaris or not, they'll station troops there afterward. With their numbers currently reduced, this is the best time to investigate.
say:103:1810766119:0.source_cn: 无论他们能否拿下诺珐斯，都必然会派兵驻守幽声群岛，眼下...

say:104:1810766120:0.text: *Cough* I do believe I just heard the most preposterous joke.
say:104:1810766120:0.source_cn: 咳咳！呵呵……余刚才似乎听到了一个惊世骇俗的笑话。

say:105:1810766121:0.text: I doubt you'd ever allow Novaris to fall into their hands, Lady Tephesia. But we have to prepare for the worst.
say:105:1810766121:0.source_cn: 你应该不会允许这种事情发生，苔佩希阁下。但我们总得为最...

say:106:1810766122:1.text: Indeed. You're a fair bit sharper after recovering your memories.
say:106:1810766122:1.source_cn: 正是如此。呵呵，你倒是比失忆前聪慧了许多。

say:110:1810766123:0.text: When are you leaving? I'm coming with you.
say:110:1810766123:0.source_cn: 你什么时候动身？我和你一起去幽声群岛。

say:111:1810766124:1.text: No. Get Estrilda to Ashvale County first, then come find me. When it comes to this, you're the only person I trust.
say:111:1810766124:1.source_cn: 不，你先护送爱丝安全返回灰影郡，再来跟我汇合。这件事上...

say:113:1810766126:0.source_cn: 等等，你现在就要走吗，巴登？<key:dialog1>

say:114:1810766127:1.text: Thane and I only just found you... and you just recovered your memories!
say:114:1810766127:1.source_cn: 我和瑟恩好不容易才找到你，你的记忆也才刚恢复！<key...

say:115:1810766128:1.text: Can't you... stay with us a little longer?
say:115:1810766128:1.source_cn: 就不能……不能和我们多待一会儿吗？<key:dialog1>

say:120:1810766131:0.source_cn: 我曾经向爱丝小姐许诺过，若有机会，一定为她演唱八音盒中...
